name: Lattice
pitch: Your whole health picture, kept on your phone.
lead: Workouts, food, weight, sleep, lab results and more in one place, on your phone. There's no account on someone else's server and nothing to sync to a company database. Your data lives on your phone, and backups go to your own Google Drive.
features: A food diary that keeps up

Search a big food database or scan a barcode, and log it in a couple of taps. Add your own AI key and Lattice reads a nutrition label from a photo or screenshot too. Mark a day complete when you're done.
Recipes and favorites
Build a recipe from its ingredients, say how many servings it makes, and Lattice works out the nutrition per serving. Tap the heart on any food and it waits in Favorites, one tap away next time.
900 exercises, plus your own

Pick from 900 exercises, most with a demo photo, step-by-step instructions and a muscle map, or add your own with a photo and how to do it. Run a session with a rest timer and see your personal bests.
Log everything about your body

Weight as often as you like, 12 body measurements, blood pressure, your CPAP nights and AHI, mood check-ins, illnesses and symptoms pinned to a body map, immunizations and supplement doses, all on one health calendar.
Your lab results, explained

Enter results from 147 tests, or add your own AI key and Lattice reads them from a screenshot. It flags each one high, low or normal by your lab's own range, charts it over the years and explains 135 in plain English.
A report for your provider

Pick 90, 180 or 365 days and Lattice sums up your nutrition and top foods, weight and body composition, exercise, glucose, sleep and CPAP by month. Customize it to what your provider cares about, then share it with them as a PDF.
Health Connect, read on your phone
Steps, sleep, heart rate and glucose from the apps you already use come in through Android's Health Connect. They stay on the phone; nothing goes to a server.
Only what you care about
Customize Home, Body Log and Trends: drag sections into the order you want and hide the ones you don't use, down to single graphs on Trends.
A Daily Action Plan
List what you want to do every day or on chosen weekdays, and check it off on Home. Logging your sleep, weight, a meal or a supplement ticks its task off for you.
Every supplement you take

Add each supplement with its brand, dose and how often, or add your own AI key and Lattice reads its Supplement Facts label for you. Log doses as taken or missed, and see your daily total of 28 nutrients as % of daily value.
Goals and Adaptive TDEE

In Profile, set your target weight, calorie goal, macro split and weekly pace. Adaptive TDEE works out what you really burn from your own weigh-ins and food log over two weeks, so your targets fit you.
22 trends in one place
Graphs for weight and calories (with your TDEE over time), body composition, weight factors, sleep, blood glucose, and heart health: HRV, resting heart rate and blood pressure.
plans: The whole app on your phone, with no ads.
A backup to your own Google Drive every day, and whenever you ask.
Connect Lattice to your own AI app, so you can ask it about your data.
When it suggests a change, nothing happens until you approve it there.
data: Your data lives on your phone, and backups go to your own Google Drive.

Signing in with Google lets Lattice save its backup in your Google Drive. Lattice asks Google only for the files it creates itself. It can't see anything else in your Drive, your Gmail or your contacts.
